description: This file defines a React component 'Grid' for displaying session information in a dashboard, including workspace grouping, session chips, and screencasts. It manages state, handles user interactions, and communicates with external channels.

classes.name: SessionChip
classes.description: A React component representing a session, displaying session details, status, and screencast, with actions to close or delete the session.

methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of a workspace group.
